The 4-Pillar Algorithm

📈 TREND SCORE
Weight: 30%
YTD momentum + daily confirmation + price discount for cheap stocks. Captures short-term market direction with longer-term context.
🏰 THE MOAT
Weight: 40%
Competitive advantage: monopolies, patents, network effects, switching costs. Determines long-term profitability and pricing power.
🚀 GROWTH TRACK
Weight: 20%
Revenue trajectory, sector momentum, and earnings direction. Identifies companies expanding market share and scaling.
💪 FINANCIAL HEALTH
Weight: 10%
Balance sheet strength, institutional backing, and defensive positioning. Ensures stability and resilience to downturns.
